name: Fishguard Foodbank
short_description: Nearest foodbank at Fishguard. Part of The Trussell Trust network. Open Wed 10am-1pm for distribution. Referral required via local agencies.

name: Pembrokeshire County Council Allotments
short_description: Pembrokeshire Council allotment sites including Crymych area
description: Council manages sites at Crymych and surrounding villages. Small plots from £20/year. Contact for Clydau specific availability.

name: Clydau Community Garden
short_description: Small community garden in the Preseli Hills
description: Volunteer-maintained garden in the Preseli Hills growing hardy vegetables and herbs suited to the upland climate. Surplus shared with elderly residents.
